name: KU Leuven
header:
KU Leuven
Belgium · Master of Mathematics, Pure Mathematics / Research option (120 ECTS); subsequent PhD in Mathematics at Arenberg
Doctoral School
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Scholarships require separate actions and earlier deadlines than ordinary admission.
• Science@Leuven adds two letters and course descriptions even where ordinary top200 exemption applies.
• Master Mind 2027 financial terms are provisional; do not budget from 2026 annual award.
• Ordinary direct PhD eligibility from BA is not established.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor can apply to the MSc through individual foreign-degree assessment; it is not
direct Flemish-degree admission. Programme describes at least 90 ECTS of broad mathematics as ideal
preparation. PhD ordinarily requires a relevant Flemish master or equivalent foreign qualification with
distinction (or distinguished research achievements), or a distinguished predoctoral exam. A BA alone is not
established as equivalent; MSc-first is the ordinary route. F-1 status does not determine Belgian
visa/fee/nationality rules. [s1] [s2] [s16]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: check the year-specific requirements, application-window and tuition selectors; create the university
application, upload core and programme documents and pay €120. Science@Leuven: first submit the degree
application, then upload its confirmation email in the separate scholarship registration; do not wait for
academic acceptance. Joint KU Leuven/Master Mind: add the candidacy annexe AND complete scholarship
registration. PhD: first secure a supervisor or funded vacancy; only that supervisor can initiate the degree
application and send its unique link. [s5] [s7] [s11] [s16]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require prior supervisor agreement. Doctoral admission expressly requires a KU
Leuven supervisor to initiate the process; contact faculty with research fit or apply to a financed vacancy.
Cluckers and Mohammadi are part-time in the algebra roster, so ask about local availability. Denef/Coppens
are emeriti and several familiar names (including Botong Wang/Lei Wu) are former members, not current
ordinary advisers. [s16] [s24]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Create application → documents/fee → submit and receive confirmation → scholarship registration where
relevant → track assessment → final degree verification before enrolment. Missing mandatory documents block
submission. A portal still accepting submissions does not mean an official deadline was extended. PhD must
use the supervisor-generated unique application link. [s3] [s5] [s16] [s18]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Scholarship dates/forms explicitly 2027-28; Mathematics academic requirements currently shown in 2026-27
guide, with standing rules. Dynamic academic deadline/tuition need applicant-specific confirmation. Master
Mind funding explicitly preliminary untilJanuary 2027; older Science microsite says 2026 closed, while
central2027call is open. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s7] [s11]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Unresolved]
The official programme directs applicants to a dynamic selector by academic year, nationality and programme;
the specific Mathematics 2027 result was not retrievable from public text. Do not substitute the March/June
dates of other faculties. The general absolute registration backstop is 22 September 2027, not a safe
international application target. For scholarship applications use the earlier dates below. PhD has no universal
deadline; vacancy/supervisor controls. [s2] [s5] [s6] [s16]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Joint Master Mind/Inspiring and nationality-specific KU Leuven scholarships: 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET
(degree file with annexe AND registration). Nominees informed by 10 March; one-minute video due 16 March
2027. Science@Leuven: 15 February 2027 (hour not given), complete degree and separate scholarship files.
Nationality-based Science tuition reduction procedure 2: 1 March 2027; procedure 1 automatic. [s7] [s11] [s12]
[s14]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
Science@Leuven requires two letters in the complete degree/scholarship file by 15 February 2027; no separate
grace period is published. Joint scholarship deadline requires a complete degree file by 15 January, but an extra
letter count/deadline is not stated in the checked 2027 page. Ordinary MSc has no explicit programme-specific
reference requirement. Doctoral vacancies can differ. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s11]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Normally English proof accompanies the application. Joint Master Mind/Inspiring explicitly allow score results
after 15 January 2027 only if the test was taken before that deadline; no final result-arrival date is given.
Science scholarship requires a complete valid file by 15 February. A qualifying US-degree exemption can
replace testing, with pending-degree treatment to confirm. [s3] [s7] [s11] [s12]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Core documents must be present to submit. Scholarship files must be complete by their dates. An
unfinished-degree applicant may submit official interim transcripts; final prior-degree verification is required
before enrolment, electronically or in person. No single public final-degree date beyond the enrolment
condition was established for Mathematics. [s3] [s7] [s11] [s18]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal Mathematics offer-acceptance deadline was found; follow the individual admission/scholarship
notice. An admission letter itself creates no enrolment/payment obligation. September 2027 is the normal
start; general registration deadline 22 September 2027, subject to earlier visa and programme deadlines. [s5]
[s16]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc Mathematics: TOEFL old scale 94, reading19/listening18/speaking19/writing21; new scale4.5,
reading4/listening4/speaking3.5/writing4.5. IELTS Academic7.0, reading6.5 and other sections6.0. Cambridge
C1/C2 185, reading176 and other sections169. General accepted formats include TOEFL Home/Paper and IELTS
Online; not TOEFL MyBest, IELTS One Skill Retake or Duolingo. PhD uses separate B2 thresholds: IELTS6.5/no
section below6; old TOEFL79 with reading18/writing23; since July 2026 new TOEFL4 with
listening/reading/speaking4, writing4.5. [s1] [s17] [s19]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed wholly English-taught US university degrees qualify for MSc exemption; UChicago BA meets the
stated location/language route once awarded. Science scholarship accepts degree/transcripts confirming the
whole course was in English; joint scholarships also explicitly exempt completed English US programmes.

Confirm provisional handling before graduation. Arenberg PhD also lists the US-degree exemption and can
assess other evidence through its doctoral committee. [s1] [s9] [s11] [s17]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload higher-education diploma(s) and official transcripts (interim official transcripts if still studying),
translations if outside English/Dutch/French/German, passport identity page, English evidence/exemption, CV,
motivation and fee evidence. Secondary-school documents are not needed for MSc. Grading
explanation/course descriptions are programme additions with the exemption below. Final degree verification
may use secure institution records, direct registrar email or original degree and final transcript in person;
institution email must identify student/application and link the registrar’s publicly listed address. [s1] [s3] [s18]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Science@Leuven explicitly asks for all credited course titles, credits/ECTS and grades, with an explanation of
the grade scale. Do not invent ECTS conversions: supply institutional workload evidence where US quarter
credits differ. Ordinary MSc transcript provides course history. [s7] [s8]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc: relevant courses need English descriptions of objectives, topics, workload and materials; online
syllabus text may be copied. Applicants from a Science exchange partner or a latest THE/QS global top-200
university are exempt from course/grading descriptions. UChicago is within the QS top200, so the ordinary
exemption appears applicable. HOWEVER Science@Leuven independently asks about half to one page of
relevant-course descriptions (content/textbooks/credits); its page does not grant the top200 exemption.
Prepare these for scholarship review. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s22]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Ordinary Mathematics MSc page does not specify a letter count. Science@Leuven requires TWO references
from internationally recognised professors. Generic recommendation templates are not evidence that all MSc
applicants need letters. PhD letters depend on vacancy/funding. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Science@Leuven adds two letters to the ordinary public Mathematics checklist. The 2027 joint Master
Mind/Inspiring pages and one-page candidacy annexe do not specify a further letter count or special referee
questions; check any nomination-stage instructions. [s7] [s11] [s13]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Science@Leuven uses letter uploads in the degree application; alternatively referees may directly email Bieke
Dutoit with applicant name and scholarship name in the subject. This is not a published automatic invitation
system. No trigger based on entering contact details was established. [s8]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No rule that referee invitations are sent only after submission was found. Science references can be uploaded
before submission or sent directly using the published alternative; request delivery before the complete-file
deadline. [s8]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The applicant receives confirmation of degree submission and separately of Science scholarship registration.

Neither is an explicit per-letter receipt confirmation. For confidential emailed letters ask the office to confirm
file completion; no public referee tracker was established. [s7] [s8]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Letter replacement/reuse across programmes or cycles is not publicly specified. A generic university DOCX
recommendation template is linked but its contents could not be read reliably in this research; no questions
from it are invented. [s3] [s8]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
CV required for MSc and doctorate. No public length limit, mandatory style or paper-link rule found. [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Motivation letter required; recommended length ONE A4 page, not an explicit maximum. Public generic prompt
is simply motivation for the programme. Science scholarship evaluates knowledge of the MSc and reasons for
choosing it. No fixed font/margins stated. [s3] [s7]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement listed for Mathematics. Joint scholarship selection considers
experience, leadership and commitment but the public candidacy annexe does not ask a separate essay. [s1]
[s3] [s11] [s13]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
No standalone MSc research-interest statement listed. For PhD discuss the topic with a prospective supervisor;
vacancy materials may request a research statement. [s1] [s16]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
MSc: none listed. Doctoral application: thesis proposal or a short vacancy description; candidates selected for
an advertised PhD do not need a comprehensive proposal under the generic rule for science. Proposal should
first be discussed with the future supervisor; general template or own format permitted. [s3] [s16]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No thesis/writing-sample upload required in the public Mathematics MSc checklist. Doctoral job/scholarship
calls may request one separately; do not send unrequested full papers. [s1] [s3]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate publications list required in the public MSc checklist. For PhD publications can support
distinction/research qualifications, but the generic science dossier does not prescribe a stand-alone list. [s3]
[s16]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Course list and relevant-course descriptions are substantive scholarship preparation; see those fields. Science
guidance says roughly half to one page for relevant course descriptions and requests course content, books
and credits, without clearly specifying whether the page count is per course or total; confirm before
compressing detailed syllabi. [s7] [s8]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Joint scholarship annexe is one page of identifying details and a declaration of candidacy, not an essay.
Separate online registration required. Nominees submit a ONE-MINUTE motivational video by 16 March 2027;
detailed prompt/format follows nomination and is not public. Science scholarship reuses the programme
motivation, adds course descriptions and two references; its separate public form asks
name/email/programme/guest ID and a PDF screenshot of submission confirmation. Interviews may cover
motivation, plans, extracurriculars and ambassador role. [s7] [s11] [s13] [s23]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Proof of fee payment if bank transfer; passport/ID; external scholarship attestation for funded doctorate where

relevant. Generic upload guidance requests unprotected PDFs, Roman-character filenames without spaces and
gives an unusual 4-15MB range: verify portal constraints rather than padding small PDFs unnecessarily. [s3]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Science@Leuven 2027: €12,000/year, plus non-EEA partial tuition reduction; residual 2027 tuition undecided
(2026-27 was €3,252.72). Inspiring 2027: ONE award, €13,200/year and full tuition waiver except about€140
annual administration. Master Mind 2027 is PROVISIONAL: KU Leuven says€10,750 covering programme
length, tuition around€1,200/year; annual interpretation is not confirmed. Prior government 2026 terms
were€10,225/year with near-full waiver and explicitly under2027review. No universal MSc stipend. PhD
scholarship net amount is individually calculated and equals an assistant’s net pay; salaried researchers use
scale43. No mathematically specific 2027 annual offer verified. [s7] [s11] [s12] [s15] [s20] [s21]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Science initially one year, renewable for a second consecutive year: standing continuation rule requires
enrolment in at least60 credits, passing all enrolled credits and excellent grades. Inspiring covers up to two
years for 120ECTS. Master Mind describes one or two years by programme length but its provisional amount
wording needs clarification. Doctoral employment/fellowship duration follows the vacancy; no automatic
MSc-to-PhD funding commitment. [s7] [s10] [s11] [s12] [s16]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Science: all nationalities except Belgian; non-Belgian bachelor, no previous KU Leuven study/work, no prior
MSc/PhD, ambassador commitment. Joint Master Mind/Inspiring: all nationalities, prior degree outside Flanders;
existing Flemish enrolment usually disqualifies except specified preparatory study/exchange exceptions.
Nationality-specific ASEAN/Africa/Central-SouthAmerica awards share the joint application; eligibility cannot be
determined from F-1 alone. [s7] [s11] [s12]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Science needs excellent bachelor results comparable to distinction and is competitive; candidates ranked,
around8 interviewed, decisions beginningMay 2027. Joint schemes judge academic performance, awards,
motivation, experience, leadership and commitment. Master Mind cannot combine with other KU
Leuven/Belgian-government/European-Commission awards; Inspiring disallows other full awards from those
sources. Funding is not guaranteed by admission. [s7] [s11] [s12]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Two independent routes: January 15 joint scholarship annexe plus registration; February 15 Science
scholarship registration after degree submission. Science registration must include PDF proof of
degree-application submission; receipt email completes registration. Eligible nationality-based Science fee
reduction may require a third form byMarch1. Do not confuse a tuition reduction with an application-fee
waiver. [s7] [s11] [s14] [s23]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Science nationality fee waiver: procedure1 automatically covers listed least-developed/low-income citizenships
(32 African and10 Asian countries on source); procedure2 is application-based for lower-middle-income
countries/territories, due1 March 2027 with degree-submission proof. All qualifying admitted applicants receive
it;2027 residual fee undecided. FWO/project PhD vacancies are separate future routes; no live matching 2027
doctoral stipend verified. Consult the official calculator for ordinary tuition by nationality/programme/year; its
numerical Mathematics result was not retrievable. [s14] [s2] [s16]
Application fee [Standing rule]
€120 nonrefundable PER degree application; pay card through portal or bank transfer plus detailed proof.
(Pre)doctoral applications are exempt. This is separate from tuition and from the approximately€140
administration charge associated with Inspiring scholarship. [s4]

Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published exemptions: (pre)doctorate, exchange, VLIR-ICP scholarship and specified named joint programmes,
plus Belgian refugee status with proof uploaded under payment. Science@Leuven or Master Mind candidacy is
not listed as an application-fee exemption; no generic hardship waiver established. [s4]

fields.text: Science: all nationalities except Belgian; non-Belgian bachelor, no previous KU Leuven study/work, no prior MSc/PhD, ambassador commitment. Joint Master Mind/Inspiring: all nationalities, prior degree outside Flanders; existing Flemish enrolment usually disqualifies except specified preparatory study/exchange exceptions. Nationality-specific ASEAN/Africa/Central-SouthAmerica awards share the joint application; eligibility cannot be determined from F-1 alone. [s7] [s11] [s12]

fields.label: Conditions and duties
fields.text: Science needs excellent bachelor results comparable to distinction and is competitive; candidates ranked, around8 interviewed, decisions beginningMay 2027. Joint schemes judge academic performance, awards, motivation, experience, leadership and commitment. Master Mind cannot combine with other KU Leuven/Belgian-government/European-Commission awards; Inspiring disallows other full awards from those sources. Funding is not guaranteed by admission. [s7] [s11] [s12]

fields.label: Extra funding application
fields.text: Two independent routes: January 15 joint scholarship annexe plus registration; February 15 Science scholarship registration after degree submission. Science registration must include PDF proof of degree-application submission; receipt email completes registration. Eligible nationality-based Science fee reduction may require a third form byMarch1. Do not confuse a tuition reduction with an application-fee waiver. [s7] [s11] [s14] [s23]

fields.label: Other funding routes
fields.text: Science nationality fee waiver: procedure1 automatically covers listed least-developed/low-income citizenships (32 African and10 Asian countries on source); procedure2 is application-based for lower-middle-income countries/territories, due1 March 2027 with degree-submission proof. All qualifying admitted applicants receive it;2027 residual fee undecided. FWO/project PhD vacancies are separate future routes; no live matching 2027 doctoral stipend verified. Consult the official calculator for ordinary tuition by nationality/programme/year; its numerical Mathematics result was not retrievable. [s14] [s2] [s16]

fields.label: Application fee
fields.text: €120 nonrefundable PER degree application; pay card through portal or bank transfer plus detailed proof. (Pre)doctoral applications are exempt. This is separate from tuition and from the approximately€140 administration charge associated with Inspiring scholarship. [s4]

fields.label: Fee waiver
fields.text: Published exemptions: (pre)doctorate, exchange, VLIR-ICP scholarship and specified named joint programmes, plus Belgian refugee status with proof uploaded under payment. Science@Leuven or Master Mind candidacy is not listed as an application-fee exemption; no generic hardship waiver established. [s4]

Pay attention to
• Scholarships require separate actions and earlier deadlines than ordinary admission.
• Science@Leuven adds two letters and course descriptions even where ordinary top200 exemption applies.
• Master Mind 2027 financial terms are provisional; do not budget from 2026 annual award.
• Ordinary direct PhD eligibility from BA is not established.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor can apply to the MSc through individual foreign-degree assessment; it is not
direct Flemish-degree admission. Programme describes at least 90 ECTS of broad mathematics as ideal
preparation. PhD ordinarily requires a relevant Flemish master or equivalent foreign qualification with
distinction (or distinguished research achievements), or a distinguished predoctoral exam. A BA alone is not
established as equivalent; MSc-first is the ordinary route. F-1 status does not determine Belgian
visa/fee/nationality rules. [s1] [s2] [s16]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: check the year-specific requirements, application-window and tuition selectors; create the university
application, upload core and programme documents and pay €120. Science@Leuven: first submit the degree
application, then upload its confirmation email in the separate scholarship registration; do not wait for
academic acceptance. Joint KU Leuven/Master Mind: add the candidacy annexe AND complete scholarship
registration. PhD: first secure a supervisor or funded vacancy; only that supervisor can initiate the degree
application and send its unique link. [s5] [s7] [s11] [s16]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require prior supervisor agreement. Doctoral admission expressly requires a KU
Leuven supervisor to initiate the process; contact faculty with research fit or apply to a financed vacancy.
Cluckers and Mohammadi are part-time in the algebra roster, so ask about local availability. Denef/Coppens
are emeriti and several familiar names (including Botong Wang/Lei Wu) are former members, not current
ordinary advisers. [s16] [s24]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Create application → documents/fee → submit and receive confirmation → scholarship registration where
relevant → track assessment → final degree verification before enrolment. Missing mandatory documents block
submission. A portal still accepting submissions does not mean an official deadline was extended. PhD must
use the supervisor-generated unique application link. [s3] [s5] [s16] [s18]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Scholarship dates/forms explicitly 2027-28; Mathematics academic requirements currently shown in 2026-27
guide, with standing rules. Dynamic academic deadline/tuition need applicant-specific confirmation. Master
Mind funding explicitly preliminary untilJanuary 2027; older Science microsite says 2026 closed, while
central2027call is open. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s7] [s11]

The official programme directs applicants to a dynamic selector by academic year, nationality and programme;
the specific Mathematics 2027 result was not retrievable from public text. Do not substitute the March/June
dates of other faculties. The general absolute registration backstop is 22 September 2027, not a safe

Joint Master Mind/Inspiring and nationality-specific KU Leuven scholarships: 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET
(degree file with annexe AND registration). Nominees informed by 10 March; one-minute video due 16 March

Nationality-based Science tuition reduction procedure 2: 1 March 2027; procedure 1 automatic. [s7] [s11] [s12]
[s14]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
Science@Leuven requires two letters in the complete degree/scholarship file by 15 February 2027; no separate
grace period is published. Joint scholarship deadline requires a complete degree file by 15 January, but an extra
letter count/deadline is not stated in the checked 2027 page. Ordinary MSc has no explicit programme-specific
reference requirement. Doctoral vacancies can differ. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s11]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Normally English proof accompanies the application. Joint Master Mind/Inspiring explicitly allow score results
after 15 January 2027 only if the test was taken before that deadline; no final result-arrival date is given.
Science scholarship requires a complete valid file by 15 February. A qualifying US-degree exemption can
replace testing, with pending-degree treatment to confirm. [s3] [s7] [s11] [s12]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Core documents must be present to submit. Scholarship files must be complete by their dates. An
unfinished-degree applicant may submit official interim transcripts; final prior-degree verification is required
before enrolment, electronically or in person. No single public final-degree date beyond the enrolment
condition was established for Mathematics. [s3] [s7] [s11] [s18]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal Mathematics offer-acceptance deadline was found; follow the individual admission/scholarship
notice. An admission letter itself creates no enrolment/payment obligation. September 2027 is the normal
start; general registration deadline 22 September 2027, subject to earlier visa and programme deadlines. [s5]

English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc Mathematics: TOEFL old scale 94, reading19/listening18/speaking19/writing21; new scale4.5,

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload higher-education diploma(s) and official transcripts (interim official transcripts if still studying),
translations if outside English/Dutch/French/German, passport identity page, English evidence/exemption, CV,
motivation and fee evidence. Secondary-school documents are not needed for MSc. Grading
explanation/course descriptions are programme additions with the exemption below. Final degree verification
may use secure institution records, direct registrar email or original degree and final transcript in person;
institution email must identify student/application and link the registrar’s publicly listed address. [s1] [s3] [s18]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Science@Leuven explicitly asks for all credited course titles, credits/ECTS and grades, with an explanation of
the grade scale. Do not invent ECTS conversions: supply institutional workload evidence where US quarter
credits differ. Ordinary MSc transcript provides course history. [s7] [s8]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc: relevant courses need English descriptions of objectives, topics, workload and materials; online
syllabus text may be copied. Applicants from a Science exchange partner or a latest THE/QS global top-200
university are exempt from course/grading descriptions. UChicago is within the QS top200, so the ordinary
exemption appears applicable. HOWEVER Science@Leuven independently asks about half to one page of
relevant-course descriptions (content/textbooks/credits); its page does not grant the top200 exemption.
Prepare these for scholarship review. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s22]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Ordinary Mathematics MSc page does not specify a letter count. Science@Leuven requires TWO references
from internationally recognised professors. Generic recommendation templates are not evidence that all MSc
applicants need letters. PhD letters depend on vacancy/funding. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Science@Leuven adds two letters to the ordinary public Mathematics checklist. The 2027 joint Master
Mind/Inspiring pages and one-page candidacy annexe do not specify a further letter count or special referee
questions; check any nomination-stage instructions. [s7] [s11] [s13]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Science@Leuven uses letter uploads in the degree application; alternatively referees may directly email Bieke
Dutoit with applicant name and scholarship name in the subject. This is not a published automatic invitation
system. No trigger based on entering contact details was established. [s8]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No rule that referee invitations are sent only after submission was found. Science references can be uploaded
before submission or sent directly using the published alternative; request delivery before the complete-file
deadline. [s8]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor can apply to the MSc through individual foreign-degree assessment; it is not
direct Flemish-degree admission. Programme describes at least 90 ECTS of broad mathematics as ideal
preparation. PhD ordinarily requires a relevant Flemish master or equivalent foreign qualification with
distinction (or distinguished research achievements), or a distinguished predoctoral exam. A BA alone is not
established as equivalent; MSc-first is the ordinary route. F-1 status does not determine Belgian
visa/fee/nationality rules. [s1] [s2] [s16]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: check the year-specific requirements, application-window and tuition selectors; create the university
application, upload core and programme documents and pay €120. Science@Leuven: first submit the degree
application, then upload its confirmation email in the separate scholarship registration; do not wait for
academic acceptance. Joint KU Leuven/Master Mind: add the candidacy annexe AND complete scholarship
registration. PhD: first secure a supervisor or funded vacancy; only that supervisor can initiate the degree
application and send its unique link. [s5] [s7] [s11] [s16]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require prior supervisor agreement. Doctoral admission expressly requires a KU
Leuven supervisor to initiate the process; contact faculty with research fit or apply to a financed vacancy.
Cluckers and Mohammadi are part-time in the algebra roster, so ask about local availability. Denef/Coppens
are emeriti and several familiar names (including Botong Wang/Lei Wu) are former members, not current
ordinary advisers. [s16] [s24]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Create application → documents/fee → submit and receive confirmation → scholarship registration where
relevant → track assessment → final degree verification before enrolment. Missing mandatory documents block
submission. A portal still accepting submissions does not mean an official deadline was extended. PhD must
use the supervisor-generated unique application link. [s3] [s5] [s16] [s18]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Scholarship dates/forms explicitly 2027-28; Mathematics academic requirements currently shown in 2026-27
guide, with standing rules. Dynamic academic deadline/tuition need applicant-specific confirmation. Master
Mind funding explicitly preliminary untilJanuary 2027; older Science microsite says 2026 closed, while
central2027call is open. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s7] [s11]

Academic application [Unresolved]
The official programme directs applicants to a dynamic selector by academic year, nationality and programme;
the specific Mathematics 2027 result was not retrievable from public text. Do not substitute the March/June
dates of other faculties. The general absolute registration backstop is 22 September 2027, not a safe
international application target. For scholarship applications use the earlier dates below. PhD has no universal
deadline; vacancy/supervisor controls. [s2] [s5] [s6] [s16]

Joint Master Mind/Inspiring and nationality-specific KU Leuven scholarships: 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET

Nationality-based Science tuition reduction procedure 2: 1 March 2027; procedure 1 automatic. [s7] [s11] [s12]

Science@Leuven requires two letters in the complete degree/scholarship file by 15 February 2027; no separate

replace testing, with pending-degree treatment to confirm. [s3] [s7] [s11] [s12]

unfinished-degree applicant may submit official interim transcripts; final prior-degree verification is required
before enrolment, electronically or in person. No single public final-degree date beyond the enrolment

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload higher-education diploma(s) and official transcripts (interim official transcripts if still studying),

motivation and fee evidence. Secondary-school documents are not needed for MSc. Grading

Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]

Course descriptions [Standing rule]

syllabus text may be copied. Applicants from a Science exchange partner or a latest THE/QS global top-200
